title: Last Train Radio
summary: A radio presenter reads the safety rules for a city on a broadcast that slowly goes wrong.
inspired_by: https://youtu.be/RVszt4A-ucc (premise only: a monster that copies a voice you know)

beats.text: This is the Port Ellis emergency broadcast. Tonight's rule: never answer a voice you cannot see.
The infected have learned to copy us. They borrow the voice of someone you love.
Test every caller with a question only the real person knows.
lines: Ask a question only they know.

beats.text: He did not know the name of their cat. She did not open the door.
Our own front desk reports a knock. A voice outside says, "Let me in, it's me."
It is my producer's voice. I ask him the name of my dog.
He answers at once, and he is right. I have never had a dog.
He is not copying her voice. He is copying mine, and I am live on air.
